messages.subject: about the configuration result
parts:
Dear Manuel,
I had been configure my python algorithm under irace several times on the same training instance and testing instance. But each time the results were different and there was a big gap between the elite configuration. Because I had only one  integer parameter needed to be configuraed and the gap always up to 5 or 6.I really confused about how it happened.

Best Regards

Zhenxi

messages.author: 854a0709976c2a48
messages.subject: Re: [irace-package] about the configuration result
parts:
Dear Zhenxi,

There are many reasons why this can happen:

* Does the parameter actually have an effect on the algorithm? If not, irace is
basically selecting one value at random and the chosen elite will be random.

* What is the variance of the algorithm across multiple runs? irace does not
magically reduce this variance (nothing will). If the variance is large enough,
some runs will be luckier than others, so irace may converge to different
elites and also the gap computed in few runs will be misleading.

* How much budget was given to irace? Some users expect to be able to run irace
with few hundred evaluations or even less just because there is one training
instance and one parameter with very few values. But this is not the scenario
for which irace was designed. In such a scenario, it is always better to do a
full factorial or fractional experimental design and no racing or a single
race, as mentioned in the user-guide. Irace is designed for the case where your
parameter space is large enough that it makes sense to do a search within it
and your budget is large enough that it makes sense to run several races.

There are many other reasons why the above may happen. Without some more
details about your set-up (scenario.txt, parameters.txt, target-runner, how do
you measure the gap, etc), it is impossible for anyone to tell.

Best wishes,

Manuel.
